name: void-haxball-mod
description: Launcher para HaxBall com interface VOID, bloqueio de anúncios e ferramentas de qualidade de vida.
author: Gabriel Vieira

scripts.test: node tests/patcher.test.js && node tests/main.test.js && node tests/discord.test.js && node tests/setup-electron.test.js && node tests/updater.test.js && node tests/release.test.js
scripts.dist: npm run check:secrets && npm test && node scripts/setup-electron.js && npm run build && node scripts/verify-build.js && npm run pack
scripts.dist:private: npm run check:secrets && npm test && node scripts/setup-electron.js && npm run build:private && node scripts/verify-build.js --private && npm run pack
